summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K disclosing no ATM share sales and no bitcoin purchases between August 31 and September 7, 2026, while holding roughly 845,050 bitcoin acquired for $63.73 billion at an average $75,412 per coin. The board raised its Digital Credit Securities Repurchase Program authorization from $1.0 billion to $2.0 billion, leaving $1.19 billion available. During the period the company repurchased 1,810,885 shares of Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred (STRC) for $176.3 million; no STRF, STRK, STRD or MSTR buybacks occurred. Watch preferred funding costs and bitcoin accumulation pace.
